_comment: Streamer Mode for World of Tanks 2.4.1 -- copy this file to <game>/mods/configs/akemi.streamermode/config.json
_mode_comment: 'label' = replace the nickname with e.g. Ally_001 / Enemy_001 (recommended); 'blank' = show nothing at all
_allyPrefix_comment: Prefix for anonymised players on YOUR team; a 3-digit counter is appended. Leave EMPTY to follow the client language automatically (友军_ on a Chinese client, Ally_ elsewhere).
_enemyPrefix_comment: Prefix for anonymised players on the ENEMY team. Leave EMPTY to follow the client language automatically (敌军_ on a Chinese client, Enemy_ elsewhere).
_namePrefix_comment: Legacy fallback for both teams. Leave EMPTY unless you want one shared prefix; allyPrefix/enemyPrefix take precedence when set.
_bot_comment: Official bots (the client shows them as ':Name Surname:'). They get their own prefix and their own counter, e.g. Bot_001. Use 机器人_ for a Chinese prefix.
_exclude_comment: Who keeps their real name. All default to true.
_hideClanTag_comment: Also hide the clan tag shown next to a stranger's name
_hideResultsClanTag_comment: The post-battle results screen reads the clan tag straight from the player record, so it needs its own switch
_badges_comment: Badges/medals drawn next to nicknames. A rare medal identifies a player about as well as the name does, so hiding is the default.
_profile_comment: When you open ONE player's details/profile, show their real name instead of the label. Set to false to keep that window masked too.
_scope_comment: Which screens are anonymised. All default to true. scope.playersPanel covers the side panels and the loading-screen team lists -- they share one switch because the loading rows are reused in battle, so splitting them left the panel half-masked. scope.tabPanel covers the full-screen TAB scoreboard.
